description.text: The last Neo set, released on 28 February 2002 with 113 cards: 105 in the main numbering and eight secret Shining Pokémon. It brought Dark Pokémon back, now from Johto too, beside Light Pokémon, their gentler counterparts, and had the last Unown but R and J; its theme decks were Dark and Light. Its Shining Pokémon, the last of their kind, have foil only on the Pokémon itself, and Neo Destiny was the last English set printed in 1st Edition.
